QuestInfo.name: Second Evan Launch Gift from the Admin
QuestInfo.0: The Maple Admin has prepared a gift for you to celebrate the launch of Evan. If you're curious about the gift, talk to the Maple Admin.
QuestInfo.1: The Maple Admin has prepared 5 different cash items that look especially good on Evan. You can get the second item from the Maple Admin when you reach Lv. 18.
QuestInfo.2: You have received your second Evan Launch Gift from the Admin.

0.0: Hello, this is the Maple Admin. It's wonderful to see that you're getting stronger day by day. Are you curious what my second gift is?

yes.0: You know that during this special event, I'm giving away 5 different Evan cash items to Evans between Lv. 17 and 21, don't you? When you equip all the Evan cash items, you will get a special effect that is exclusively for Evans!
yes.1: Please come see me when you're ready to receive my second gift.

no.0: It's a special gift that will be given out only until May 4th, so hurry over if you want it!
